title: Disposal Matrix
lede: Is every disposal obligation discharged exactly once on every path, and is every use after disposal or transfer rejected or caught by a recorded runtime check? Every cell cites the spec text that decides it, or is marked open with a counterexample program.
legend: Decided: one rule (or a consistent set) settles the verdict and the bound. Missing: no text decides it. Ambiguous: one passage, two readings with different verdicts. Conflict: two passages disagree. Select a cell for its rule, citation and counterexample.
